projects.title: Warren Lotas — Jewelry
projects.description: I led the development of a rodeo-style belt buckle in sterling silver, with gold-plated details and blue enamel accents, and a sterling silver money clip for two separate Warren Lotas releases. Working from the creative director's concept sketches, I refined the final illustrations and created tech packs to guide model makers and jewelry vendors from 2D artwork through 3D development and production.

projects.title: The Brink Of
projects.description: As lead designer for The Brink Of, a feature film about a music duo navigating their creative and romantic relationship, I created a visual identity for the film and the real-life band. Drawing on the music, film footage, and 1970s bands like Fleetwood Mac, I developed film posters, single artwork, and visual assets for streaming services, sales, PR, marketing, social media, and touring.

projects.title: WL Trophy Room
projects.description: For Warren Lotas collaborations with the NBA, NFL, and NCAA/CLC, I conceptualized and illustrated team graphics and apparel, reimagining mascots and logos through the brand's visual language. The work included detailed hoodie and T-shirt illustrations alongside long-sleeve and shorts graphics, with pieces sold as stadium exclusives and showcased at the opening of the official NBA store in New York.

projects.title: WL Western Pulp Drop
projects.description: I led the graphics team and creative direction for a Warren Lotas release exploring the Western Pulps theme. Alongside contributing original illustrations, I curated pieces to form a cohesive collection that carried the brand's punk, biker, and spaghetti western influences into new graphics and apparel.

projects.title: Emo Nite
projects.description: Emo Nite is a traveling music event celebrating emo music and culture in clubs and theaters across the country. I was commissioned to concept and develop apparel graphics for tour merchandise and the Emo Nite website, creating designs that fit the brand's provocative aesthetic and rebellious spirit.

projects.title: Village Mice TCG
projects.description: Working with artist Steven Savoca (@fathersteve), I helped shape the brand identity and visual language for Village Mice, a trading card game featuring his mouse artwork. The work spanned translating initial sketches into digital illustrations, formatting the cards, and designing packaging to turn Steve's artistic vision into a collectible card game.
